facts.fact: NVIDIA's blog says Tunisia has adopted a national strategy for AI and digitalization that includes promoting AI education and research.

facts.fact: Novation City in Sousse deployed Tunisia's first NVIDIA DGX system in February 2024, according to its chief innovation officer quoted by NVIDIA.
NVIDIA says the Novation City DGX system has empowered about 30 startups across the continent, and that the hub gives AI startups and researchers access to DGX infrastructure.
